{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data types
print(sales_df.dtypes)

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values:')
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nDuplicate rows:')
print(sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check unique values in key columns
print('\nUnique values in customer_segment:')
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].unique())

print('\nUnique values in status:')
print(sales_df['status'].unique())

# Check the distribution of revenue as string
print('\nSample of revenue strings:')
print(sales_df['revenue'].head(10))"}
